1.3 Upon Party A’s written confirmation of the design renderings, such renderings shall be appended to this 
Contract as Appendix [●] and shall form an integral part hereof. In principle, no further modifications shall be 
made after confirmation unless otherwise agreed in writing.

The total contract price for this project shall be USD [●] (in words: [●]).
(Note: The quotation is on an EXW (Ex Works) basis and includes: □ Equipment Cost □ Freight □ Installation □ 
Unloading □ Special Invoice)

4.1 Within three (3) business days after the execution of this Contract, Party A shall pay a 50% deposit to 
Party B, amounting to USD [●] (in words: [●]).

4.2 Upon completion of production by Party B, Party A shall pay the remaining 50% balance (the “shipment 
payment”) to Party B’s designated account, amounting to USD [●] (in words: [●]). Party B shall arrange for
dispatch only after receipt of the full shipment payment.

The delivery lead time shall be ______ calendar days from the date of receipt of the deposit (excluding public 
holidays). Any delay in dispatch or any loss incurred by Party A due to reasons attributable to Party A shall 
not be the responsibility of Party B.

Party B shall not be responsible for arranging transportation or delivery of the goods unless otherwise 
requested and authorized by Party A in writing. If Party A requests Party B to assist with logistics 
arrangements, Party B may provide such assistance on behalf of Party A, and all related costs, including but 
not limited to freight charges, customs clearance fees, insurance, taxes, handling fees, and any other 
transportation-related expenses, shall be borne solely by Party A.

Party B’s assistance in arranging logistics shall not be deemed as Party B acting as a carrier, freight forwarder, 
or transportation provider. Party B shall not be liable for any delay, loss, damage, customs issues, accidents, 
or other incidents arising from or related to the services provided by any third-party logistics provider, 
carrier, shipping company, customs agent, or other external parties.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Party A shall be responsible for arranging transportation, receiving the 
goods, and providing sufficient personnel and equipment for unloading at the designated delivery location. 
The number of unloading personnel required shall be determined by Party A based on the volume, weight, 
and nature of the goods.

The installation service is not included in the product quotation and is subject to the additional service fee 
specified below. The installation commencement date shall be determined by mutual agreement between the 
Parties, taking into consideration personnel availability, travel arrangements, site readiness, and other relevant 
factors. The installation services shall be governed by the following Project Installation Service Plan. Selected 
option (to be agreed by both Parties): __________.
